references.text: The oak in Saanannim is also mentioned in connection with Heber the Kenite's tent, near Kedesh, which provides geographical context to Naphtali's border area.
The introduction to the description of Naphtali's inheritance, as verse 33 continues with the boundary description.
Continuation of Naphtali's boundary description, showing the western and southern borders that supplement the information in verse 33.
Jordan is mentioned as the eastern border of the promised land, just as Naphtali's border ends at the Jordan.
The Jordan Valley is described as a border area, providing geographical context to Naphtali's eastern border at the Jordan.
